authorized_by: HUMAN_OPERATOR_EXPLICIT, 2026-08-14: 'Do not rewrite the historical #1227 custody record. Also do not claim primaryModelId was an independent confirmation of the served model.' Append-only correction record authorized; no fresh substantive audit required solely for this correction.
discovered_by: TP-DMX-SECOND-BRAIN-ADR-ACCEPTANCE-002 (Phase B), from its own two audit rounds on grok CLI 1.0.3

corrects.why_not_modified: It accurately records what was known and believed when it was written, and it is merged, audited evidence. The custody rule this program has used throughout is that a reconciliation adds a record rather than revising one; the record being corrected here was itself created under that rule.

what_was_claimed: That summary.json current_model_id and signals.json primaryModelId were two agreeing sources establishing the round-2 auditor model as grok-4.5.
what_is_wrong_with_it: The two fields are not independent. signals.json primaryModelId tracks the runner's default/aggregate model, not the model that served the audited turns. It agreed with current_model_id on grok CLI 1.0.0 only because grok-4.5 was also the default at that version. On CLI 1.0.3 it reads grok-4.6 even when -m grok-4.5 is pinned and every per-turn and per-message record says grok-4.5.

corrected_evidence_hierarchy.weight: runner/usage telemetry corroboration; grok-4.5-build is a runner-internal usage label for grok-4.5 and is not a requestable model id, as already established in proof/TP-DMX-SECOND-BRAIN-ADR-ACCEPTANCE-001-AC2-AMENDMENT/GROK_AUDIT_ROUTE_CUSTODY.json
runner-default metadata — NOT independent served-model evidence
UNKNOWN — none exists for this route

evidence_that_strengthens_the_unchanged_.note: The corrected hierarchy leaves the conclusion better supported than the original reasoning claimed, not weaker. Two evidence classes present in the same session were never cited by the original record.

what_remains_true_in_the_corrected_recor: The round-2 audit of PR #1227 was served by grok-4.5.
The historical invocation contained no -m flag and has not been rewritten to add one.
evidence_class RUNNER_SESSION_METADATA_VERIFIED remains accurate; this correction sharpens which fields within that class carry weight.
no_fresh_audit_required: Operator-ruled. The correction changes no conclusion, no verdict, no disposition and no artifact under audit. It narrows the evidentiary weight of one metadata field.
forward_rule: Auditor-identity reconciliation must cite events.jsonl turn_started.model_id and chat_history.jsonl per-message model_id. signals.json primaryModelId may be recorded for completeness but must never be presented as independent corroboration of the served model.
